subject.title: fix: handle Claude CLI synthetic placeholders

question: Should exact Claude CLI `<synthetic>` placeholders with no visible assistant text route through existing model fallback as `empty_result`, or should OpenClaw use a status-only/session-preservation behavior instead?
rationale: The patch is a narrow implementation, but it changes fallback and reused-session semantics for an auth/provider runtime path, and repository policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision.

options.title: Accept Narrow Fallback Semantics
options.body: Land this direction after mergeability refresh if exact known Claude CLI placeholders should become fallback-worthy empty results while visible output and hook/incomplete-turn guards keep precedence.

options.title: Pair With Session Preservation
options.body: Coordinate this PR with the open reused-session preservation work if maintainers want placeholder classification and session cleanup reviewed as one recovery story.

options.title: Use Status-Only Recovery
options.body: Pause or close this approach if maintainers want synthetic placeholders to produce observability without cross-provider model fallback.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Fallback Semantics
recommendation.body: Land this direction after mergeability refresh if exact known Claude CLI placeholders should become fallback-worthy empty results while visible output and hook/incomplete-turn guards keep precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest feature-history owner for the Claude CLI parser, CLI runner, and fallback classifier surfaces involved in this decision.
